OPENAI_API_URL.title: API endpoint URL (thường sẽ kết thúc với đuôi 'v1')

OPENAI_API_temperature.title: Sampling: temperature
OPENAI_API_temperature.subtitle: 0.0 → 2.0: lower = more deterministic, higher = more random

OPENAI_API_top_p.title: Sampling: top P
OPENAI_API_top_p.subtitle: 0.0 → 1.0: for example 0.1 = output sampled only from the top 10% probability tokens

OPENAI_API_frequency_penalty.title: Frequency penalty
OPENAI_API_frequency_penalty.subtitle: -2.0 → 2.0: higher = prevent repetition = reduction if the token has appeared has appeared multiple times

OPENAI_API_presence_penalty.title: Presence penalty
OPENAI_API_presence_penalty.subtitle: -2.0 → 2.0: higher = newer things = reduction if the token has appeared at least once before
